prompt:
Premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and cozy felt with visible fiber texture, softly rounded scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, tiny stitched details, real button holes and twisted yarn fibers, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers. Saturated coral, marigold, teal, leaf green, plum and sky blue on warm cream. Child-safe preschool proportions, handmade warmth. No vector art, no glossy plastic, no text unless the prompt explicitly requests the title.

A precise four-column by two-row family of large pre-reader papercraft tool icons on one perfectly flat uniform dark-charcoal background. Exactly eight separate circular layered-cardstock badges, one centered in each equal invisible cell, matching size, thick cream rim, simple high-contrast cut-paper glyph, no overlap. Reading order: clockwise curved turn arrow; small flower with an inward arrow for smaller; large flower with an outward arrow for bigger; curved undo arrow; blank torn paper sheet for fresh paper; framed landscape picture for save picture; warm golden five-point finish rosette; stitched teal gallery book. No words, letters, numerals, labels, cell borders, hands, duplicates, or extra objects.
